title: Hanako-san: the girl in the third stall

scenes.title: HANAKO-SAN
scenes.text: In schools all over Japan, children whisper one rule: never knock on the third stall.
scenes.image_prompt: a dark abandoned Japanese elementary school at night, huge pale moon, one red glowing window on the third floor, fog, bare tree, iron fence

scenes.label: 3RD FLOOR
scenes.text: She waits on the third floor, in the third stall of the girls' bathroom.
scenes.image_prompt: close view of the third floor windows of a dark school at night, one window glowing red, fog

scenes.text: At night, the hallway goes silent. The lights begin to flicker.
scenes.image_prompt: a long empty school corridor at night, flickering fluorescent lights, a small silhouette of a girl at the far end, red exit sign

scenes.label: THE 3RD STALL
scenes.text: The ritual is simple. You walk in alone, and stand in front of the third door.
scenes.image_prompt: a row of old teal toilet stalls in a school bathroom, the third door slightly open, darkness inside, red eyes glowing

scenes.text: Knock three times. Then ask: Hanako-san, are you there?
scenes.image_prompt: extreme close-up of a worn teal bathroom stall door, scratches, a red lock indicator, small shoes visible in the gap under the door

scenes.title: I AM HERE
scenes.text: And if the legend is true, a small voice answers: I am here.
scenes.image_prompt: pitch black darkness with a pale girl's face with a bob haircut, glowing red eyes, horror comic style

scenes.text: Some say she is only a lonely girl. Others say she is something else.
scenes.image_prompt: silhouette of a little girl with a bob haircut standing in a bright bathroom doorway, glowing red eyes, fog on the floor

scenes.text: Nobody knows where the story began. Some folklorists trace it back to the nineteen fifties.
scenes.image_prompt: an old empty school corridor in the 1950s, wooden floor, dark windows, moonlight, dust

scenes.text: And every generation of children keeps daring each other to knock.
scenes.image_prompt: an empty school bathroom with a row of stalls, cold light, silent, ominous

scenes.title: WOULD YOU KNOCK?
scenes.text: So tell me. Would you knock?
scenes.image_prompt: a single bathroom stall door in dark lighting, one pale small hand under the door

scenes.title: LEGENDS
scenes.text: Next legend: the forest nobody walks through at night. Follow if you dare.
